verdict.rationale: The docs show LobeChat works with multiple model backends: self-hosting guides for Azure OpenAI and Ollama, Gemini 3.6 Flash support, Kimi K3 with reasoning-effort controls in a model list, and trial access to GLM, GPT-6 and MiniMax models. None of the evidence shows switching models per agent or per conversation, or names Anthropic or OpenRouter. missing for 10: explicit Anthropic and OpenRouter provider support, documented per-agent/per-conversation model switching, bring-your-own-key provider configuration docs, independent hands-on corroboration
